record.context_brief: Fourier-Mukai questions for Enriques Kuznetsov components
record.original_question: Let X be an Enriques surface and let Ku(X, L) be the Kuznetsov component in a semiorthogonal decomposition Db(X) = <Ku(X, L), L>. Do the Fourier-Mukai existence questions from Questions 1.7 and 1.8 have a positive answer when D_i is taken to be a Kuznetsov component Ku(X_i, L_i) of an Enriques surface?

evidence.quote: Question 2.9. (iii) Does Question 1.7 or Question 1.8, with Di := Ku(Xi , Li ), have a positive answer for the Kuznetsov component Ku(X, L)?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $k$ be an algebraically closed field of characteristic different from $2$. For an Enriques surface $X$ over $k$, fix a line bundle $L \in \mathrm{Pic}(X)$ such that $L$ is an exceptional object in the bounded derived category of coherent sheaves $D^b(X)$, and consider the semiorthogonal decomposition
$$D^b(X) \;=\; \langle \mathrm{Ku}(X,L),\; L\rangle,$$
where the Kuznetsov component $\mathrm{Ku}(X,L)$ is the right orthogonal of $L$ in $D^b(X)$. Recall that an exact functor $F\colon \mathcal D_1 \to \mathcal D_2$ between admissible subcategories $\mathcal D_i \hookrightarrow D^b(Y_i)$ of derived categories of smooth projective varieties $Y_i$ over $k$ is said to be of Fourier–Mukai type if there exist an object $E \in D^b(Y_1 \times Y_2)$ and natural isomorphisms making $F$ isomorphic to the restriction of the integral functor
$$\Phi_E(-) \;=\; (p_2)_*\bigl(E \otimes^{\mathbb L} p_1^*(-)\bigr)$$
to $\mathcal D_1$, with image landing in $\mathcal D_2$.

Settle the following two questions in this Enriques-surface setting. Let $X_1, X_2$ be Enriques surfaces over $k$ with chosen line bundles $L_1, L_2$ as above, and write $\mathcal D_i := \mathrm{Ku}(X_i, L_i)$.

(a) Is every exact fully faithful functor $F\colon \mathcal D_1 \to \mathcal D_2$ of Fourier–Mukai type?

(b) Given any exact equivalence $F\colon \mathcal D_1 \to \mathcal D_2$, does there exist a (possibly different) Fourier–Mukai equivalence $\mathcal D_1 \simeq \mathcal D_2$?
artifact.status_search_result: The question is posed as an open problem in a 2022 survey on categorical Torelli theorems. Existing categorical Torelli results for Enriques surfaces assume the equivalence between the Kuznetsov components is already of Fourier–Mukai type; the Fourier–Mukai-type property itself for arbitrary (fully faithful) functors between Enriques Kuznetsov components does not appear to have been established. Related Fourier–Mukai-type results have been proved for Kuznetsov components of certain Gushel–Mukai varieties and quartic double solids, but not, to our knowledge, for Enriques surfaces. No publication settling this case was located.

status_evidence.title: Categorical Torelli theorems: results and open problems (PMC)
status_evidence.snippet: Question 2.7/2.8 ask whether fully faithful functors / equivalences between admissible subcategories are of Fourier–Mukai type; Question 2.9 raises the case of the Enriques Kuznetsov component.
status_evidence.claim: The Fourier–Mukai questions for Enriques Kuznetsov components are explicitly listed as open problems.

status_evidence.title: A refined derived Torelli theorem for Enriques surfaces
status_evidence.snippet: Establishes a categorical Torelli theorem for Enriques surfaces under the hypothesis that the equivalence of Kuznetsov components is of Fourier–Mukai type.
status_evidence.claim: Existing categorical Torelli results for Enriques surfaces require the Fourier–Mukai hypothesis rather than proving it.
